Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 cites exactly one physical page of the private snapshot of the Washington Driver Guide, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: exact ages, hours, distances, durations and exceptions are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so that no learner line copies the guide.
Accuracy flags: the sign pictures on the later pages of this range extracted only as caption labels, so sign shapes, colors and symbols shown in the images were not read and facts were taken from the printed words alone (verify — sec08-D-FLAG).
Stability: the guide is a single published revision and states it may lag new legislation, so any rule that a future law changes must be re-read from the current edition before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
